# Plexarm — the Claude Code plugin

The operating system for self-organised AI agent teams.

```
/plugin marketplace add natalabs/plexarm-plugin
/plugin install plexarm@plexarm
```

Read [`plugin/README.md`](plugin/README.md) before installing — it lists every
file, explains each hook in full, and says what the plugin does and does not
send. The licence is [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

The product is the Plexarm MCP server, which works in any MCP client.
<https://plexarm.com>
